name: directory/data
command: d=/data; if test -L "$d"; then echo LINK; elif test -d "$d"; then echo DIRECTORY; elif test -e "$d"; then echo OTHER; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: directory/data/local
command: d=/data/local; if test -L "$d"; then echo LINK; elif test -d "$d"; then echo DIRECTORY; elif test -e "$d"; then echo OTHER; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: directory/data/local/tmp
command: d=/data/local/tmp; if test -L "$d"; then echo LINK; elif test -d "$d"; then echo DIRECTORY; elif test -e "$d"; then echo OTHER; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: directory/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs1
command: d=/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs1; if test -L "$d"; then echo LINK; elif test -d "$d"; then echo DIRECTORY; elif test -e "$d"; then echo OTHER; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: directory/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs8
command: d=/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs8; if test -L "$d"; then echo LINK; elif test -d "$d"; then echo DIRECTORY; elif test -e "$d"; then echo OTHER; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: stock/result
command: d=/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs1; f=$d/result; if test ! -L $d && test -d $d && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then tail -n 20 $f | head -c 4096; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: stock/done
command: d=/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs1; f=$d/done; if test ! -L $d && test -d $d && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then tail -n 20 $f | head -c 4096; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: stock/install.log
command: d=/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs1; f=$d/install.log; if test ! -L $d && test -d $d && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then tail -n 20 $f | head -c 4096; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: upgrade/result
command: d=/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs8; f=$d/result; if test ! -L $d && test -d $d && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then tail -n 20 $f | head -c 4096; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: upgrade/done
command: d=/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs8; f=$d/done; if test ! -L $d && test -d $d && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then tail -n 20 $f | head -c 4096; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: upgrade/install.log
command: d=/data/local/tmp/x2d-rs8; f=$d/install.log; if test ! -L $d && test -d $d && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then tail -n 20 $f | head -c 4096; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: menu
command: d=/tmp; f=/tmp/x2d-native-menu-preload.status; if test ! -L $d && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then head -c 4096 $f; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: worker
command: f=/tmp/x2d-pixel-overclock/status.json; if test ! -L /tmp/x2d-pixel-overclock && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then head -c 4096 $f | /system/xbin/busybox base64; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: ui
command: d=/tmp/x2d-pixel-overclock; f=/tmp/x2d-pixel-overclock/ui.txt; if test ! -L $d && test ! -L $f && test -f $f; then head -c 4096 $f; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: mount
command: awk '$2=="/system"{print $4}' /proc/mounts

name: lock
command: if test -e /tmp/x2d-multishot-active; then echo PRESENT; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: native_error
command: /bin/dbus-send --system --print-reply --dest=com.hasselblad.error /error org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.GetAll string:com.hasselblad.error | head -c 8192 | /system/xbin/busybox base64

name: exposure
command: /bin/dbus-send --system --print-reply --dest=com.hasselblad.camera /camera org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:com.hasselblad.camera string:exposure_status 2>&1|/system/xbin/busybox base64;true

name: storage
command: /bin/dbus-send --system --print-reply --dest=com.hasselblad.storage /storage org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:com.hasselblad.storage string:storage_status 2>&1|/system/xbin/busybox base64;true

name: job_root/mnt/media_rw/ssd
command: d=/mnt/media_rw/ssd; if test -L "$d"; then echo LINK; elif test -d "$d"; then echo DIRECTORY; test -w "$d" && echo WRITABLE || echo NOT_WRITABLE; elif test -e "$d"; then echo OTHER; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: job_root/mnt/media_rw/ssd/multishot
command: d=/mnt/media_rw/ssd/multishot; if test -L "$d"; then echo LINK; elif test -d "$d"; then echo DIRECTORY; test -w "$d" && echo WRITABLE || echo NOT_WRITABLE; elif test -e "$d"; then echo OTHER; else echo ABSENT; fi

name: job_mount
command: awk '$2=="/mnt/media_rw/ssd"{print $3,$4;n++} END{if(!n)print "ABSENT"}' /proc/mounts

name: task/task.info
command: j=/mnt/media_rw/ssd/multishot/ABSENT; f=$j/task.info; test -d "$j" && test ! -L "$j" && test ! -L "$f" && test -f "$f" && tail -c 2048 "$f"|/system/xbin/busybox base64; true

name: current_memory
command: head -n 5 /proc/meminfo;pidof camera-service camera-storage
path: 当前系统内存和服务 PID

name: archive/last-task.txt
command: d=/tmp/x2d-pixel-overclock; f=$d/last-task.txt; test ! -L "$d" && test ! -L "$f" && test -f "$f" && head -c 6000 "$f"|/system/xbin/busybox base64; true

name: archive/last-failed-task.txt

name: service_failures
command: logcat -d -v threadtime 2>/dev/null|grep -iE "ion_alloc.*failed|VmemAlloc.*failed|Assertion Failed|pre allocated|called exit"|tail -c 4096|/system/xbin/busybox base64; true
path: 历史服务异常摘录，不自动归属任务
